scope: all local Pump/memecoin paper-trade ledgers; no live orders

legacy_cutover.observation_limit: n_open is the last published in-process scorecard count, approximately 11 seconds before termination; position identities and exact sizes were never persisted and cannot be reconstructed
legacy_cutover.reason: legacy resolution-only ledgers mixed cost regimes and silently dropped open positions on restart
legacy_cutover.scope: legacy PAPER sniper core arms retired before clean V2 start
legacy_cutover.stress_policy: all 70 observed-open legacy positions are cutover dropouts and count as full notional loss for system-level stress; exact R is unknowable because their entry sizes/cost commitments were not retained

sniper.scope: all local sniper resolution ledgers; parallel variants are separate tests
sniper.unresolved_trade_count_reason: legacy entries/open positions were not persisted; identities before cutover are unknowable. The final published open count is preserved in the cutover receipt and full-loss stressed.

v3_retirement.decision: All three arms exceeded the frozen N=100 minimum and failed the preregistered positive full-loss-stress mean/equity gate. New paper entries are disabled; already-open positions resolve normally through the event-sourced book.
v3_retirement.safety: PAPER ONLY. No wallet, signer, order, transfer or on-chain write was added or enabled.
